roleTitle: Launch Program Manager, Video Conferencing Service
jobDescription: The video conferencing service hosts meetings for business customers on a shared multi-tenant platform. The Launch Program Manager runs feature launches into the live service: has launched features to the whole customer base through staged rollouts, owns the launch readiness review and the rollout schedule, watches launch health with the SRE team and handles rollback decisions with engineering, and documents the boundaries of each launch. Beta programme experience is relevant but does not by itself cover the launch responsibilities. The role reports to the head of release management and works with four feature teams, SRE and customer communications across every launch.
requirements: Has launched features to the whole customer base through staged rollouts.
Owns the launch readiness review and the rollout schedule for the live service.
Watches launch health with SRE and handles rollback decisions with engineering.
Runs closed beta programmes with a readiness checklist and weekly feedback triage.
Documents beta findings, limitations and hand-over conditions in a beta exit report.

evidence.text: Ran the closed beta programme for the video conferencing service on the beta environment, managing four feature betas with invited customer accounts and running the beta readiness checklist before each beta opened.
Triaged beta feedback with the feature teams each week, keeping the feedback log and the fix list that gated each beta's exit.

The staged rollout to the general customer base, the launch health monitoring and the rollback calls were run by the release management team and SRE after beta exit; my involvement ended with the hand-over.
Wrote the beta exit report for each feature, listing the beta environment's limitations, the unresolved feedback and the hand-over conditions given to release management.
Around two years on the beta programme covered beta planning, invited-account management, readiness checklists, feedback triage and beta exit reports for four features.
Work sample: the beta readiness checklist and the beta exit report for the breakout-rooms feature, with the beta environment's build identifiers and the invited-account list as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she 'launched four features to the whole customer base' and 'ran the rollouts end to end'; asked about rollback calls, she said SRE 'pulled the lever' but that she 'made the launch calls'.

Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's talk abstract from a product conference reads 'shipping features to millions of meeting participants'; the head of release management wants a program manager who has owned a staged rollout and a rollback, so the packet must separate beta from general release.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the closed beta programme on the beta environment for four features with invited customer accounts, running the readiness checklist and weekly feedback triage.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the checklist document the betas and their environment.

propositions.text: The candidate wrote the beta exit report for each feature, listing the beta environment's limitations, unresolved feedback and hand-over conditions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the exit report document the reports.

propositions.text: The candidate launched features to the whole customer base through staged rollouts and handled the rollback decisions.
propositions.rationale: The resume confines the candidate to the closed beta and places the staged rollout, launch monitoring and rollback calls with release management and SRE; her screen remarks about launch calls are her own account.

gold.expectedGap: The materials document closed betas on the beta environment; they do not document the candidate launching to the general customer base, owning a rollout schedule or making rollback decisions.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the stage the resume names: closed beta with invited accounts; staged rollout, launch monitoring and rollback belonged to release management and SRE.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever owned a staged rollout to all customers or a rollback decision herself, and for which feature.
